contexts.text: Ye have turned... the fruit of justice into wormwood () = goods turned into wormwood. ( = to turn good into evil. AE 355:34.) See AE 519:6.

The name of the star is called Wormwood, and the third part of the earth became wormwood () = the infernal falsity from which is their Own intelligence, through which all the truths of the Word have been falsified. ( = truth mixed with falsity of evil. AE 519. AE 520.)
That wormwood = infernal falsity, is from its strong bitterness, by which it renders food and drink abominable. Illustrated.
